text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 7.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: BEOL device's absolute Tj, which is unmeasured. Decode is the verified thermal worst case: prefill duty is 0.08-0.41% against decode's 4.80%.
